thread:
Aisha Khan: hey support — customer org `red-falcon` reporting they cannot view audit trail after migrating to new OIDC provider. UI shows "You don't have permission to view audit logs" and API calls get 403 with body: {"error":"insufficient_scope"}.

Tom B: got the org id / user id? any repro steps?

Aisha Khan: org=org_7812, user alice@red-falcon.com. Repro steps I used:
```
# grab token via OIDC auth code flow (idp is new-oidc.example)
curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=...'
# then call audit endpoint
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_7812/audit/logs
```
Response: 403, body:
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "message": "token missing required scope: audit:read"
}

Jamal R: can you paste the raw token introspection or decoded JWT (redact user info)? need to see scopes/claims.

Aisha Khan: pasted decoded JWT (redacted):
```
{
  "iss": "https://new-oidc.example/",
  "sub": "user|1234",
  "aud": ["redwood-api"],
  "exp": 1718464552,
  "iat": 1718460952,
  "scp": "openid profile email audit:read",
  "email": "alice@red-falcon.com"
}
```
Note: it's `scp` not `scope`.

SupportBot: automated check: entitlement-service lookup for org_7812 => audit_log_read: false, audit_retention_entitled: false. (This is an automated hint, see /internal/ent-check).

Tom B: aha. our token parser expects `scope` claim or `scope` string field. some providers (Azure AD) use `scp`. We should accept both. Did the customer have audit entitlement before migration?

Aisha Khan: yes, they had audit read + 365d retention enabled before. After migration permissions dropped.

ComplianceOps: quick context: entitlements come from SCIM group mappings during SSO provisioning. When we saw a blank `scope` claim the sync cleared the entitlement for this identity. If tokens now carry `scp` we should map that during provisioning/introspection.

Jamal R: temporary mitigation: we can grant org-level entitlement via internal admin API while we fix the sync. Example (ops only):
```
POST /internal/orgs/org_7812/entitlements
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
{ "entitlements": { "audit_log_read": true, "audit_retention_days": 365 } }
```
Do we want to do that?

Aisha Khan: customer is blocked for compliance reporting. They requested immediate access. I propose: 1) grant temp entitlement, 2) fix sync to accept `scp` claim, 3) run repair job to reapply entitlements for all orgs that migrated in last 48h, 4) rotate any temp grants and notify customer + security.

Tom B: agree. assigning to SRE to implement parser fix + run backfill. Jamal can you own the admin grant and the repair job?

Jamal R: taking it. I'll: - issue temp entitlement now - open SRE ticket to update oidc parsing (accept scp & scope) - schedule backfill job for orgs with last_provisioned > 2024-11-01 and < now and with entitlements mismatch.

ComplianceOps: note retention entitlement (audit_retention_days) is stored separately; backfill must copy previously asserted retention from provisioning logs if available, else default to org policy and we will contact customers where we must make manual decision.

Aisha Khan: Jamal — please paste confirmation when temp grant is applied and include the admin API response / job id. I'll notify customer and keep thread updated.

Jamal R: applied temp grant at 1728464020. Admin API response: {"status":"ok","job_id":"job_9445"}. Running backfill start job job_9446 now (queued). SRE ticket #SRE-457 created to update OIDC parser.

SupportBot: ticket updated: #SRE-457 assigned to eng-runtime, severity P2.

Aisha Khan: customer notified, they confirmed they can now view audit logs via UI and API. Will keep open until backfill completes. Thanks. :raised_hands:

Tom B: postmortem/action items:
- eng-runtime: accept `scp` claim and unify parsing (SRE-457)
- infra: run backfill job job_9446 for affected orgs (Jamal)
- compliance: validate retention values for backfilled orgs and reach out if ambiguous (ComplianceOps)
- support: create KB article for SSO migrations and entitlements (Aisha)

Aisha Khan: marking as ongoing; will close when job_9446 finishes and ops confirms revocation of temp grant (expected 24h).

SupportBot: thread note added: escalation -> compliance + eng-runtime.

ComplianceOps: FYI — likely root cause: OIDC provider change to expose `scp` vs `scope` during provisioning/introspection. We'll include test vectors in SRE ticket.

Jamal R: last update: job_9446 completed at 1728464120, repaired 6 orgs, no ambiguous retention cases. I will schedule temp grant revocation at 1728467720 (24h).

Aisha Khan: thanks everyone — closing once revocation job runs.
